verses.en: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
verses.pt: Não julgueis, para que não sejais julgados.
verses.en_web: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
verses.en_bbe: Be not judges of others, and you will not be judged.

verses.en: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
verses.pt: Porque com o juízo que julgardes sereis julgados; e com a medida que medirdes vos medirão de volta.
verses.en_web: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
verses.en_bbe: For as you have been judging, so you will be judged, and with your measure will it be measured to you.

verses.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.pt: Ora, por que vês o cisco que está no olho de teu irmão e não enxergas a trave que está em teu próprio olho?
verses.en_web: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
verses.en_bbe: And why do you take note of the grain of dust in your brother's eye, but take no note of the bit of wood which is in your eye?

verses.en: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
verses.pt: Ou como dirás a teu irmão: “Deixa-me tirar o cisco do teu olho”, se eis que há uma trave em teu próprio olho?
verses.en_web: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye;’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?
verses.en_bbe: Or how will you say to your brother, Let me take out the grain of dust from your eye, when you yourself have a bit of wood in your eye?

verses.en: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother’s eye.
verses.pt: Hipócrita! Tira primeiro a trave do teu olho, e então verás claramente para tirar o cisco do olho de teu irmão.
verses.en_web: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.
verses.en_bbe: You false one, first take out the bit of wood from your eye, then will you see clearly to take out the grain of dust from your brother's eye.

verses.en: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
verses.pt: Não deis o que é santo aos cães, nem lanceis vossas pérolas diante dos porcos, para não acontecer de as pisarem com os pés e, virando-se, vos despedacem.
verses.en_web: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.
verses.en_bbe: Do not give that which is holy to the dogs, or put your jewels before pigs, for fear that they will be crushed under foot by the pigs whose attack will then be made against you.

verses.en: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
verses.pt: Pedi, e vos será dado; buscai, e achareis; batei, e vos será aberto;
verses.en_web: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
verses.en_bbe: Make a request, and it will be answered; what you are searching for you will get; give the sign, and the door will be open to you:

verses.en: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.pt: Pois qualquer um que pede recebe; e quem busca acha; e ao que bate lhe é aberto.
verses.en_web: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
verses.en_bbe: Because to everyone who makes a request, it will be given; and he who is searching will get his desire, and to him who gives the sign, the door will be open.

verses.en: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
verses.pt: E quem há dentre vós que, se seu filho pedir pão, lhe dará uma pedra?
verses.en_web: Or who is there among you, who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
verses.en_bbe: Or which of you, if his son makes a request for bread, will give him a stone?

verses.en: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
verses.pt: E se pedir peixe, lhe dará uma serpente?
verses.en_web: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?
verses.en_bbe: Or if he makes a request for a fish, will give him a snake?

verses.en: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
verses.pt: Ora, se vós, sendo maus, sabeis dar bons presentes a vossos filhos, quanto mais o vosso Pai, que está nos céus, dará coisas boas aos que lhe pedirem!
verses.en_web: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
verses.en_bbe: If you, then, being evil, are able to give good things to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who make requests to him?

verses.en: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.pt: Portanto tudo o que quiserdes que os outros vos façam, fazei-lhes vós também assim; porque esta é a Lei e os Profetas.
verses.en_web: Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.en_bbe: All those things, then, which you would have men do to you, even so do you to them: because this is the law and the prophets.

verses.en: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
verses.pt: Entrai pela porta estreita; porque larga é a porta, e espaçoso o caminho que leva à perdição; e muitos são os que por ela entram.
verses.en_web: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those who enter in by it.
verses.en_bbe: Go in by the narrow door; for wide is the door and open is the way which goes to destruction, and great numbers go in by it.

verses.en: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
verses.pt: Porque estreita é a porta, e apertado o caminho que leva à vida; e são poucos os que a acham.
verses.en_web: How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.
verses.en_bbe: For narrow is the door and hard the road to life, and only a small number make discovery of it.

verses.en: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
verses.pt: Tende cuidado, porém, com os falsos profetas, que vêm a vós com roupa de ovelhas, mas por dentro são lobos vorazes.
verses.en_web: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
verses.en_bbe: Be on the watch for false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inside they are cruel wolves.

verses.en: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
verses.pt: Vós os conhecereis pelos seus frutos. Por acaso se colhem uvas dos espinheiros, ou figos dos cardos?
verses.en_web: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
verses.en_bbe: By their fruits you will get knowledge of them. Do men get grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

verses.en: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
verses.pt: Assim toda boa árvore dá bons frutos, mas a arvore má dá frutos maus.
verses.en_web: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit; but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
verses.en_bbe: Even so, every good tree gives good fruit; but the bad tree gives evil fruit.

verses.en: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.pt: A boa árvore não pode dar frutos maus, nem a árvore má dar bons frutos.
verses.en_web: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
verses.en_bbe: It is not possible for a good tree to give bad fruit, and a bad tree will not give good fruit.

verses.en: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.pt: Toda árvore que não dá bom fruto é cortada e lançada ao fogo.
verses.en_web: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.
verses.en_bbe: Every tree which does not give good fruit is cut down and put in the fire.

verses.en: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
verses.pt: Portanto vós os conhecereis pelos seus frutos.
verses.en_web: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
verses.en_bbe: So by their fruits you will get knowledge of them.

verses.en: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.pt: Não é qualquer um que me diz: “Senhor, Senhor” que entrará no Reino dos céus; mas sim aquele que faz a vontade do meu Pai que está nos céus.
verses.en_web: Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
verses.en_bbe: Not everyone who says to me, Lord, Lord, will go into the kingdom of heaven; but he who does the pleasure of my Father in heaven.

verses.en: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
verses.pt: Muitos me dirão naquele dia: “Senhor, Senhor! Não profetizamos em teu nome? E em teu nome não expulsamos os demônios? E em teu nome não fizemos muitas maravilhas?”
verses.en_web: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’
verses.en_bbe: A great number will say to me on that day, Lord, Lord, were we not prophets in your name, and did we not by your name send out evil spirits, and by your name do works of power?

verses.en: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
verses.pt: Então claramente lhes direi: “Nunca vos conheci. Afastai-vos de mim, transgressores!”
verses.en_web: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
verses.en_bbe: And then will I say to them, I never had knowledge of you: go from me, you workers of evil.

verses.en: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
verses.pt: Portanto todo o que ouve estas minhas palavras e as pratica, eu o compararei ao homem prudente, que construiu sua casa sobre a rocha.
verses.en_web: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house on a rock.
verses.en_bbe: Everyone, then, to whom my words come and who does them, will be like a wise man who made his house on a rock;

verses.en: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.pt: E a chuva desceu, correntezas vieram, ventos sopraram, e atingiram aquela casa; e ela não caiu, porque estava fundada sobre a rocha.
verses.en_web: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
verses.en_bbe: And the rain came down and there was a rush of waters and the winds were driving against that house, but it was not moved; because it was based on the rock.

verses.en: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
verses.pt: Porém todo o que ouve estas minhas palavras e não as pratica, eu o compararei ao homem tolo, que construiu sua casa sobre a areia.
verses.en_web: Everyone who hears these words of mine, and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man, who built his house on the sand.
verses.en_bbe: And everyone to whom my words come and who does them not, will be like a foolish man who made his house on sand;

verses.en: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
verses.pt: E a chuva desceu, correntezas vieram, ventos sopraram, e atingiram aquela casa; e ela caiu, e sua queda foi grande.
verses.en_web: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell—and great was its fall.”
verses.en_bbe: And the rain came down and there was a rush of waters and the winds were driving against that house; and it came down and great was its fall.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus terminou estas palavras, as multidões estavam admiradas de sua doutrina,
verses.en_web: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
verses.en_bbe: And it came about, when Jesus had come to the end of these words, that the people were surprised at his teaching,

verses.en: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.pt: porque ele os ensinava como tendo autoridade, e não como os escribas.
verses.en_web: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
verses.en_bbe: for he was teaching as one having authority, and not as their scribes.
